name: Roster Lookup
_site: Where this build is already deployed. The refresh job checks out a clean tree, so the previously published league.json exists nowhere on the runner; it is fetched from here instead, and republished unchanged when a scrape comes back short. Stale beats wrong.
_league: members are the names to look for in the opponent column of teamId's page, which is how the seven resolve themselves rather than rotting in a list. ids is the escape hatch for the one name that doesn't resolve — a season Poland doesn't play a member, or a school joeeitel respells there (it prints "East" on the region page for what the team page calls "Youngstown East"). Anything still unresolved abandons the run rather than shipping a table one team short.
_opponentAliases: Names one school answers to, mapped to the one we file it under. Key is the tidied name lowercased with punctuation dropped.
